ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱقْتَرَبَ لِلنَّاسِ حِسَابُهُمْ وَهُمْ فِى غَفْلَةٍ مُّعْرِضُونَ
en: (1) [The time of] their account has approached for the people, while they are in heedlessness turning away.
tr: Iqtaraba lin-nāsi ḥisābuhum wahum fī ghaflatim muʿriḍūn

ar: مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِم مُّحْدَثٍ إِلَّا ٱسْتَمَعُوهُ وَهُمْ يَلْعَبُونَ
en: (2) No mention [i.e., revelation] comes to them anew from their Lord except that they listen to it while they are at play
tr: Mā yaʾtīhim min dhikrim mir rabbihim muḥdathin illastamaʿūhu wahum yalʿabūn

ar: لَاهِيَةً قُلُوبُهُمْ وَأَسَرُّوا۟ ٱلنَّجْوَى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ هَلْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ أَفَتَأْتُونَ ٱلسِّحْرَ وَأَنتُمْ تُبْصِرُونَ
en: (3) With their hearts distracted. And those who do wrong conceal their private conversation, [saying], "Is this [Prophet] except a human being like you? So would you approach magic while you are aware [of it]?"
tr: Lāhiyatan qulūbuhum, waʾasarrun-najwā, al-ladhīna ẓalamū, hal hādhā illā basharum mithlukum, afataʾtūnas-siḥra waʾantum tubṣirūn

ar: قَالَ رَبِّى يَعْلَمُ ٱلْقَوْلَ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
en: (4) He [the Prophet (ﷺ)] said, "My Lord knows whatever is said throughout the heaven and earth, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing."
tr: Qāla rabbī yaʿlamul-qawla fis-samāʾi wal-arḍ, wahuwas-samīʿul-ʿalīm

ar: بَلْ قَالُوٓا۟ أَضْغَٰثُ أَحْلَٰمٍۭ بَلِ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ بَلْ هُوَ شَاعِرٌ فَلْيَأْتِنَا بِـَٔايَةٍ كَمَآ أُرْسِلَ ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
en: (5) But they say, "[The revelation is but] a mixture of false dreams; rather, he has invented it; rather, he is a poet. So let him bring us a sign just as the previous [messengers] were sent [with miracles]."
tr: Bal qālū aḍghāthu aḥlāmim baliftarāhu bal huwa shāʿir, falyaʾtinā biʾāyatin kamā ursilal-awwalūn

ar: مَآ ءَامَنَتْ قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَٰهَآ أَفَهُمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ
en: (6) Not a [single] city which We destroyed believed before them,[872] so will they believe?
enNotes: [872]- Even though they had witnessed signs and miracles.
tr: Mā āmanat qablahum min qaryatin ahlaknāhā, afahum yuʾminūn

ar: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًا نُّوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِمْ فَسْـَٔلُوٓا۟ أَهْلَ ٱلذِّكْرِ إِن كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
en: (7) And We sent not before you, [O Muḥammad], except men to whom We revealed [the message], so ask the people of the message [i.e., former scriptures] if you do not know.
tr: Wamā arsalnā qablaka illā rijālan nūḥī ilayhim fasʾalū ahladh-dhikri in kuntum lā taʿlamūn

ar: وَمَا جَعَلْنَٰهُمْ جَسَدًا لَّا يَأْكُلُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ خَٰلِدِينَ
en: (8) And We did not make them [i.e., the prophets] forms not eating food,[873] nor were they immortal [on earth].
enNotes: [873]- Like the angels. Rather, they were human beings with human attributes.
tr: Wamā jaʿalnāhum jasadal lā yaʾkulūnaṭ-ṭaʿāma wamā kānū khālidīn

ar: ثُمَّ صَدَقْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْوَعْدَ فَأَنجَيْنَٰهُمْ وَمَن نَّشَآءُ وَأَهْلَكْنَا ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
en: (9) Then[874] We fulfilled for them the promise, and We saved them and whom We willed and destroyed the transgressors.
enNotes: [874]- Once they had conveyed the message.
tr: Thumma ṣadaqnāhumul-waʿda faʾanjaynāhum waman nashāʾu waʾahlaknal-musrifīn

ar: لَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ كِتَٰبًا فِيهِ ذِكْرُكُمْ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
en: (10) We have certainly sent down to you a Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] in which is your mention.[875] Then will you not reason?
enNotes: [875]- This implies the honor of having been mentioned or addressed. Another meaning is "your reminder."
tr: Laqad anzalnā ilaykum kitāban fīhi dhikrukum, afalā taʿqilūn

ar: وَكَمْ قَصَمْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ كَانَتْ ظَالِمَةً وَأَنشَأْنَا بَعْدَهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
en: (11) And how many a city which was unjust[876] have We shattered and produced after it another people.
enNotes: [876]- i.e., its inhabitants persisting in wrongdoing.
tr: Wakam qaṣamnā min qaryatin kānat ẓālimataw waʾanshaʾnā baʿdahā qawman ākharīn

ar: فَلَمَّآ أَحَسُّوا۟ بَأْسَنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنْهَا يَرْكُضُونَ
en: (12) And when they [i.e., its inhabitants] perceived Our punishment, at once they fled from it.
tr: Falammā aḥassū baʾsanā idhā hum minhā yarkuḍūn

ar: لَا تَرْكُضُوا۟ وَٱرْجِعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَآ أُتْرِفْتُمْ فِيهِ وَمَسَٰكِنِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْـَٔلُونَ
en: (13) [Some angels said], "Do not flee but return to where you were given luxury and to your homes - perhaps you will be questioned."[877]
enNotes: [877]- About what happened to you. This is said to them in sarcasm and ridicule.
tr: Lā tarkuḍū warjiʿū ilā mā utriftum fīhi wamasākinikum laʿallakum tusʾalūn

ar: قَالُوا۟ يَٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
en: (14) They said, "O woe to us! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."
tr: Qālū yāwaylanā innā kunnā ẓālimīn

ar: فَمَا زَالَت تِّلْكَ دَعْوَىٰهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَعَلْنَٰهُمْ حَصِيدًا خَٰمِدِينَ
en: (15) And that declaration of theirs did not cease until We made them [as] a harvest [mowed down], extinguished [like a fire].
tr: Famā zālat tilka daʿwāhum ḥattā jaʿalnāhum ḥaṣīdan khāmidīn

ar: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ
en: (16) And We did not create the heaven and earth and that between them in play.
tr: Wamā khalaqnas-samāʾa wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā lāʿibīn

ar: لَوْ أَرَدْنَآ أَن نَّتَّخِذَ لَهْوًا لَّٱتَّخَذْنَٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّآ إِن كُنَّا فَٰعِلِينَ
en: (17) Had We intended to take a diversion,[878] We could have taken it from [what is] with Us - if [indeed] We were to do so.
enNotes: [878]- Such as a wife or a child.
tr: Law aradnā an nattakhidha lahwal lattakhadhnāhu mil ladunnā, in kunnā fāʿilīn

ar: بَلْ نَقْذِفُ بِٱلْحَقِّ عَلَى ٱلْبَٰطِلِ فَيَدْمَغُهُۥ فَإِذَا هُوَ زَاهِقٌ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْوَيْلُ مِمَّا تَصِفُونَ
en: (18) Rather, We dash the truth upon falsehood, and it destroys it,[879] and thereupon it departs. And for you is destruction from that which you describe.[880]
enNotes:
[879]- Literally, "strikes its brain," disabling or killing it.
[880]- Of untruth concerning Allāh, particularly here, the claim that He has a son or other "partner" in divinity.
tr: Bal naqdhifu bil-ḥaqqi ʿalal-bāṭili fayadmaghuhū faʾidhā huwa zāhiq, walakumul-waylu mimmā taṣifūn

ar: وَلَهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَنْ عِندَهُۥ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِهِۦ وَلَا يَسْتَحْسِرُونَ
en: (19) To Him belongs whoever is in the heavens and the earth. And those near Him [i.e., the angels] are not prevented by arrogance from His worship, nor do they tire.
tr: Walahū man fis-samāwāti wal-arḍ, waman ʿindahū lā yastakbirūna ʿan ʿibādatihī walā yastaḥsirūn

ar: يُسَبِّحُونَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ لَا يَفْتُرُونَ
en: (20) They exalt [Him] night and day [and] do not slacken.
tr: Yusabbiḥūnal-layla wan-nahāra lā yafturūn

ar: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَةً مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ هُمْ يُنشِرُونَ
en: (21) Or have they [i.e., men] taken for themselves gods from the earth who resurrect [the dead]?
tr: Amittakhadhū ālihatam minal-arḍi hum yunshirūn

ar: لَوْ كَانَ فِيهِمَآ ءَالِهَةٌ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ لَفَسَدَتَا فَسُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
en: (22) Had there been within them [i.e., the heavens and earth] gods besides Allāh, they both would have been ruined. So exalted is Allāh, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.
tr: Law kāna fīhimā ālihatun illallāhu lafasadatā, fasubḥānallāhi rabbil-ʿarshi ʿammā yaṣifūn

ar: لَا يُسْـَٔلُ عَمَّا يَفْعَلُ وَهُمْ يُسْـَٔلُونَ
en: (23) He is not questioned about what He does, but they will be questioned.
tr: Lā yusʾalu ʿammā yafʿalu wahum yusʾalūn

ar: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً قُلْ هَاتُوا۟ بُرْهَٰنَكُمْ هَٰذَا ذِكْرُ مَن مَّعِىَ وَذِكْرُ مَن قَبْلِى بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْحَقَّ فَهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ
en: (24) Or have they taken gods besides Him? Say, [O Muḥammad], "Produce your proof. This [Qur’ān] is the message for those with me and the message of those before me."[881] But most of them do not know the truth, so they are turning away.
enNotes: [881]- All previous prophets called for the worship of Allāh alone.
tr: Amittakhadhū min dūnihī ālihah, qul hātū burhānakum, hādhā dhikru mam maʿiya wadhikru man qablī, bal aktharuhum lā yaʿlamūnal-ḥaqqa fahum muʿriḍūn

ar: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا نُوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعْبُدُونِ
en: (25) And We sent not before you any messenger except We revealed to him that, "There is no deity except Me, so worship Me."
tr: Wamā arsalnā min qablika mir rasūlin illā nūḥī ilayhi annahū lā ilāha illā ana faʿbudūn

ar: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَلَدًا سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ بَلْ عِبَادٌ مُّكْرَمُونَ
en: (26) And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken a son." Exalted is He! Rather, they[882] are [but] honored servants.
enNotes: [882]- Those they claim to be "children" of Allāh, such as the angels, Ezra, Jesus, etc.
tr: Waqāluttakhadhar-raḥmānu waladan subḥānah, bal ʿibādum mukramūn

ar: لَا يَسْبِقُونَهُۥ بِٱلْقَوْلِ وَهُم بِأَمْرِهِۦ يَعْمَلُونَ
en: (27) They cannot precede Him in word, and they act by His command.
tr: Lā yasbiqūnahū bil-qawli wahum biʾamrihī yaʿmalūn

ar: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يَشْفَعُونَ إِلَّا لِمَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ وَهُم مِّنْ خَشْيَتِهِۦ مُشْفِقُونَ
en: (28) He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them,[883] and they cannot intercede except on behalf of one whom He approves. And they, from fear of Him, are apprehensive.
enNotes: [883]- See footnote to 20:110.
tr: Yaʿlamu mā bayna aydīhim wamā khalfahum walā yashfaʿūna illā limanirtaḍā wahum min khashyatihī mushfiqūn

ar: وَمَن يَقُلْ مِنْهُمْ إِنِّىٓ إِلَٰهٌ مِّن دُونِهِۦ فَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِيهِ جَهَنَّمَ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
en: (29) And whoever of them should say, "Indeed, I am a god besides Him" - that one We would recompense with Hell. Thus do We recompense the wrongdoers.
tr: Wamay yaqul minhum innī ilāhum min dūnihī fadhālika najzīhi jahannam, kadhālika najziẓ-ẓālimīn

ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ كَانَتَا رَتْقًا فَفَتَقْنَٰهُمَا وَجَعَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ حَىٍّ أَفَلَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
en: (30) Have those who disbelieved not considered that the heavens and the earth were a joined entity, and then We separated them and made from water every living thing? Then will they not believe?
tr: Awalam yaral-ladhīna kafarū annas-samāwāti wal-arḍa kānatā ratqan fafataqnāhumā, wajaʿalnā minal-māʾi kulla shayʾin ḥayy, afalā yuʾminūn

ar: وَجَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ رَوَٰسِىَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِهِمْ وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا فِجَاجًا سُبُلًا لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
en: (31) And We placed within the earth firmly set mountains, lest it should shift with them, and We made therein [mountain] passes [as] roads that they might be guided.
tr: Wajaʿalnā fil-arḍi rawāsiya an tamīda bihim, wajaʿalnā fīhā fijājan subulal laʿallahum yahtadūn

ar: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ سَقْفًا مَّحْفُوظًا وَهُمْ عَنْ ءَايَٰتِهَا مُعْرِضُونَ
en: (32) And We made the sky a protected ceiling, but they, from its signs,[884] are turning away.
enNotes: [884]- The signs present in the heavens.
tr: Wajaʿalnas-samāʾa saqfam maḥfūẓā, wahum ʿan āyātihā muʿriḍūn

ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ كُلٌّ فِى فَلَكٍ يَسْبَحُونَ
en: (33) And it is He who created the night and the day and the sun and the moon; all [heavenly bodies] in an orbit are swimming.
tr: Wahuwal-ladhī khalaqal-layla wan-nahāra wash-shamsa wal-qamar, kullun fī falakiy yasbaḥūn

ar: وَمَا جَعَلْنَا لِبَشَرٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ ٱلْخُلْدَ أَفَإِي۟ن مِّتَّ فَهُمُ ٱلْخَٰلِدُونَ
en: (34) And We did not grant to any man before you eternity [on earth]; so if you die - would they be eternal?
tr: Wamā jaʿalnā libasharim min qablikal-khuld, afaʾim mitta fahumul-khālidūn

ar: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَآئِقَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ وَنَبْلُوكُم بِٱلشَّرِّ وَٱلْخَيْرِ فِتْنَةً وَإِلَيْنَا تُرْجَعُونَ
en: (35) Every soul will taste death. And We test you with evil and with good as trial; and to Us you will be returned.
tr: Kullu nafsin dhāʾiqatul-mawt, wanablūkum bish-sharri wal-khayri fitnah, waʾilaynā turjaʿūn

ar: وَإِذَا رَءَاكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى يَذْكُرُ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَهُم بِذِكْرِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ هُمْ كَٰفِرُونَ
en: (36) And when those who disbelieve see you, [O Muḥammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "Is this the one who mentions [i.e., insults] your gods?" And they are, at the mention of the Most Merciful, disbelievers.
tr: Waʾidhā raʾākal-ladhīna kafarū iy yattakhidhūnaka illā huzuwā, ahādhal-ladhī yadhkuru ālihatakum, wahum bidhikrir-raḥmāni hum kāfirūn

ar: خُلِقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مِنْ عَجَلٍ سَأُو۟رِيكُمْ ءَايَٰتِى فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُونِ
en: (37) Man was created of haste [i.e., impatience]. I will show you My signs [i.e., vengeance], so do not impatiently urge Me.
tr: Khuliqal-insānu min ʿajal, saʾurīkum āyātī falā tastaʿjilūn

ar: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
en: (38) And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
tr: Wayaqūlūna matā hādhal-waʿdu in kuntum ṣādiqīn

ar: لَوْ يَعْلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ حِينَ لَا يَكُفُّونَ عَن وُجُوهِهِمُ ٱلنَّارَ وَلَا عَن ظُهُورِهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
en: (39) If those who disbelieved but knew the time when they will not avert the Fire from their faces or from their backs and they will not be aided...[885]
enNotes: [885]- The completion of the sentence is understood to be "...they would not be asking in disbelief and ridicule to be shown the punishment."
tr: Law yaʿlamul-ladhīna kafarū ḥīna lā yakuffūna ʿaw wujūhihimun-nāra walā ʿan ẓuhūrihim walā hum yunṣarūn

ar: بَلْ تَأْتِيهِم بَغْتَةً فَتَبْهَتُهُمْ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ رَدَّهَا وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ
en: (40) Rather, it will come to them unexpectedly and bewilder them, and they will not be able to repel it, nor will they be reprieved.
tr: Bal taʾtīhim baghtatan fatabhatuhum falā yastaṭīʿūna raddahā walā hum yunẓarūn

ar: وَلَقَدِ ٱسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَحَاقَ بِٱلَّذِينَ سَخِرُوا۟ مِنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
en: (41) And already were messengers ridiculed before you, but those who mocked them were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
tr: Walaqadistuhziʾa birusulim min qablika faḥāqa bil-ladhīna sakhirū minhum mā kānū bihī yastahziʾūn

ar: قُلْ مَن يَكْلَؤُكُم بِٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ مِنَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ بَلْ هُمْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِم مُّعْرِضُونَ
en: (42) Say, "Who can protect you at night or by day from the Most Merciful?" But they are, from the remembrance of their Lord, turning away.
tr: Qul may yaklaʾukum bil-layli wan-nahāri minar-raḥmān, bal hum ʿan dhikri rabbihim muʿriḍūn

ar: أَمْ لَهُمْ ءَالِهَةٌ تَمْنَعُهُم مِّن دُونِنَا لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَلَا هُم مِّنَّا يُصْحَبُونَ
en: (43) Or do they have gods to defend them other than Us? They are unable [even] to help themselves, nor can they be protected from Us.
tr: Am lahum ālihatun tamnaʿuhum min dūninā, lā yastaṭīʿūna naṣra anfusihim walā hum minnā yuṣḥabūn

ar: بَلْ مَتَّعْنَا هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ طَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْعُمُرُ أَفَلَا يَرَوْنَ أَنَّا نَأْتِى ٱلْأَرْضَ نَنقُصُهَا مِنْ أَطْرَافِهَآ أَفَهُمُ ٱلْغَٰلِبُونَ
en: (44) But, [on the contrary], We have provided good things for these [disbelievers] and their fathers until life was prolonged for them. Then do they not see that We set upon the land, reducing it from its borders?[886] Is it they who will overcome?
enNotes: [886]- See footnote to 13:41.
tr: Bal mattaʿnā hāʾulāʾi waʾābāʾahum ḥattā ṭāla ʿalayhimul-ʿumur, afalā yarawna annā naʾtil-arḍa nanquṣuhā min aṭrāfihā, afahumul-ghālibūn

ar: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أُنذِرُكُم بِٱلْوَحْىِ وَلَا يَسْمَعُ ٱلصُّمُّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا مَا يُنذَرُونَ
en: (45) Say, "I only warn you by revelation." But the deaf do not hear the call when they are warned.
tr: Qul innamā undhirukum bil-waḥy, walā yasmaʿuṣ-ṣummud-duʿāʾa idhā mā yundharūn

ar: وَلَئِن مَّسَّتْهُمْ نَفْحَةٌ مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ يَٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
en: (46) And if [as much as] a whiff of the punishment of your Lord should touch them, they would surely say, "O woe to us! Indeed, we have been wrongdoers."
tr: Walaʾim massathum nafḥatum min ʿadhābi rabbika layaqūlunna yāwaylanā innā kunnā ẓālimīn

ar: وَنَضَعُ ٱلْمَوَٰزِينَ ٱلْقِسْطَ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فَلَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْـًٔا وَإِن كَانَ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍ مِّنْ خَرْدَلٍ أَتَيْنَا بِهَا وَكَفَىٰ بِنَا حَٰسِبِينَ
en: (47) And We place the scales of justice for the Day of Resurrection, so no soul will be treated unjustly at all. And if there is [even] the weight of a mustard seed,[887] We will bring it forth. And sufficient are We as accountant.
enNotes: [887]- i.e., anything as small or insignificant as a mustard seed.
tr: Wanaḍaʿul-mawāzīnal-qisṭa liyawmil-qiyāmati falā tuẓlamu nafsun shayʾā, waʾin kāna mithqāla ḥabbatim min khardalin ataynā bihā, wakafā binā ḥāsibīn

ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ ٱلْفُرْقَانَ وَضِيَآءً وَذِكْرًا لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
en: (48) And We had already given Moses and Aaron the criterion and a light and a reminder[888] for the righteous
enNotes: [888]- These are three qualities of the Torah.
tr: Walaqad ātaynā mūsā wahārūnal-furqāna waḍiyāʾaw wadhikral lil-muttaqīn

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَهُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّاعَةِ مُشْفِقُونَ
en: (49) Who fear their Lord unseen,[889] while they are of the Hour apprehensive.
enNotes: [889]- Which can mean "Him being unseen" by them or "though they are unseen" by others.
tr: Al-ladhīna yakhshawna rabbahum bil-ghaybi wahum minas-sāʿati mushfiqūn

ar: وَهَٰذَا ذِكْرٌ مُّبَارَكٌ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ أَفَأَنتُمْ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ
en: (50) And this [Qur’ān] is a blessed message which We have sent down. Then are you with it unacquainted?[890]
enNotes: [890]- i.e., pretending ignorance, disapproving or refusing to acknowledge it?
tr: Wahādhā dhikrum mubārakun anzalnāh, afaʾantum lahū munkirūn

ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ رُشْدَهُۥ مِن قَبْلُ وَكُنَّا بِهِۦ عَٰلِمِينَ
en: (51) And We had certainly given Abraham his sound judgement before,[891] and We were of him well-Knowing
enNotes: [891]- i.e., before Moses. Allāh had guided him from early youth.
tr: Walaqad ātaynā ibrāhīma rushdahū min qablu wakunnā bihī ʿālimīn

ar: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا هَٰذِهِ ٱلتَّمَاثِيلُ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنتُمْ لَهَا عَٰكِفُونَ
en: (52) When he said to his father and his people, "What are these statues to which you are devoted?"
tr: Idh qāla liʾabīhi waqawmihī mā hādhihit-tamāthīlul-latī antum lahā ʿākifūn

ar: قَالُوا۟ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا لَهَا عَٰبِدِينَ
en: (53) They said, "We found our fathers worshippers of them."
tr: Qālū wajadnā ābāʾanā lahā ʿābidīn

ar: قَالَ لَقَدْ كُنتُمْ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُمْ فِى ضَلَٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
en: (54) He said, "You were certainly, you and your fathers, in manifest error."
tr: Qāla laqad kuntum antum waʾābāʾukum fī ḍalālim mubīn

ar: قَالُوٓا۟ أَجِئْتَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ أَمْ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱللَّٰعِبِينَ
en: (55) They said, "Have you come to us with truth, or are you of those who jest?"
tr: Qālū ajiʾtanā bil-ḥaqqi am anta minallāʿibīn

ar: قَالَ بَل رَّبُّكُمْ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَهُنَّ وَأَنَا۠ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّٰهِدِينَ
en: (56) He said, "[No], rather, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth who created them, and I, to that, am of those who testify.
tr: Qāla bar rabbukum rabbus-samāwāti wal-arḍil-ladhī faṭarahunn, waʾana ʿalā dhālikum minash-shāhidīn

ar: وَتَٱللَّهِ لَأَكِيدَنَّ أَصْنَٰمَكُم بَعْدَ أَن تُوَلُّوا۟ مُدْبِرِينَ
en: (57) And [I swear] by Allāh, I will surely plan against your idols after you have turned and gone away."
tr: Watallāhi laʾakīdanna aṣnāmakum baʿda an tuwallū mudbirīn

ar: فَجَعَلَهُمْ جُذَٰذًا إِلَّا كَبِيرًا لَّهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِ يَرْجِعُونَ
en: (58) So he made them into fragments, except a large one among them, that they might return to it [and question].
tr: Fajaʿalahum judhādhan illā kabīral lahum laʿallahum ilayhi yarjiʿūn

ar: قَالُوا۟ مَن فَعَلَ هَٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَآ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
en: (59) They said, "Who has done this to our gods? Indeed, he is of the wrongdoers."
tr: Qālū man faʿala hādhā biʾālihatinā innahū laminaẓ-ẓālimīn

ar: قَالُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا فَتًى يَذْكُرُهُمْ يُقَالُ لَهُۥٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ
en: (60) They said, "We heard a young man mention them who is called Abraham."
tr: Qālū samiʿnā fatay yadhkuruhum yuqālu lahū ibrāhīm

ar: قَالُوا۟ فَأْتُوا۟ بِهِۦ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِ ٱلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْهَدُونَ
en: (61) They said, "Then bring him before the eyes of the people that they may testify."[892]
enNotes: [892]- To what they had heard him say. It may also mean "...that they may witness [what will be done to him as punishment]."
tr: Qālū faʾtū bihī ʿalā aʿyunin-nāsi laʿallahum yashhadūn

ar: قَالُوٓا۟ ءَأَنتَ فَعَلْتَ هَٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَا يَٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ
en: (62) They said, "Have you done this to our gods, O Abraham?"
tr: Qālū aʾanta faʿalta hādhā biʾālihatinā yā ibrāhīm

ar: قَالَ بَلْ فَعَلَهُۥ كَبِيرُهُمْ هَٰذَا فَسْـَٔلُوهُمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ يَنطِقُونَ
en: (63) He said, "Rather, this - the largest of them - did it, so ask them, if they should [be able to] speak."
tr: Qāla bal faʿalahū kabīruhum hādhā fasʾalūhum in kānū yanṭiqūn

ar: فَرَجَعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّكُمْ أَنتُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ
en: (64) So they returned to [blaming] themselves and said [to each other], "Indeed, you are the wrongdoers."
tr: Farajaʿū ilā anfusihim faqālū innakum antumuẓ-ẓālimūn

ar: ثُمَّ نُكِسُوا۟ عَلَىٰ رُءُوسِهِمْ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يَنطِقُونَ
en: (65) Then they reversed themselves,[893] [saying], "You have already known that these do not speak!"
enNotes: [893]- After first admitting their error, they were seized by pride and obstinacy.
tr: Thumma nukisū ʿalā ruʾūsihim, laqad ʿalimta mā hāʾulāʾi yanṭiqūn

ar: قَالَ أَفَتَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُكُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يَضُرُّكُمْ
en: (66) He said, "Then do you worship instead of Allāh that which does not benefit you at all or harm you?
tr: Qāla afataʿbudūna min dūnillāhi mā lā yanfaʿukum shayʾaw walā yaḍurrukum

ar: أُفٍّ لَّكُمْ وَلِمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
en: (67) Uff[894] to you and to what you worship instead of Allāh. Then will you not use reason?"
enNotes: [894]- An exclamation of anger and displeasure.
tr: Uffil lakum walimā taʿbudūna min dūnillāh, afalā taʿqilūn

ar: قَالُوا۟ حَرِّقُوهُ وَٱنصُرُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ فَٰعِلِينَ
en: (68) They said, "Burn him and support your gods - if you are to act."
tr: Qālū ḥarriqūhu wanṣurū ālihatakum in kuntum fāʿilīn

ar: قُلْنَا يَٰنَارُ كُونِى بَرْدًا وَسَلَٰمًا عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
en: (69) We [i.e., Allāh] said, "O fire, be coolness and safety upon Abraham."
tr: Qulnā yānāru kūnī bardaw wasalāman ʿalā ibrāhīm

ar: وَأَرَادُوا۟ بِهِۦ كَيْدًا فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْأَخْسَرِينَ
en: (70) And they intended for him a plan [i.e., harm], but We made them the greatest losers.
tr: Waʾarādū bihī kaydan fajaʿalnāhumul-akhsarīn

ar: وَنَجَّيْنَٰهُ وَلُوطًا إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِى بَٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا لِلْعَٰلَمِينَ
en: (71) And We delivered him and Lot to the land which We had blessed for the worlds [i.e., peoples].
tr: Wanajjaynāhu walūṭan ilal-arḍil-latī bāraknʾa fīhā lil-ʿālamīn

ar: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ نَافِلَةً وَكُلًّا جَعَلْنَا صَٰلِحِينَ
en: (72) And We gave him Isaac and Jacob in addition, and all [of them] We made righteous.
tr: Wawahabnā lahū isḥāqa wayaʿqūba nāfilah, wakullan jaʿalnā ṣāliḥīn

ar: وَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِمْ فِعْلَ ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَإِقَامَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَإِيتَآءَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةِ وَكَانُوا۟ لَنَا عَٰبِدِينَ
en: (73) And We made them leaders guiding by Our command. And We inspired to them the doing of good deeds, establishment of prayer, and giving of zakāh; and they were worshippers of Us.
tr: Wajaʿalnāhum aʾimmatay yahdūna biʾamrinā waʾawḥaynā ilayhim fiʿlal-khayrāti waʾiqāmaṣ-ṣalāti waʾītāʾaz-zakāh, wakānū lanā ʿābidīn

ar: وَلُوطًا ءَاتَيْنَٰهُ حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا وَنَجَّيْنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِى كَانَت تَّعْمَلُ ٱلْخَبَٰٓئِثَ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمَ سَوْءٍ فَٰسِقِينَ
en: (74) And to Lot We gave judgement and knowledge, and We saved him from the city that was committing wicked deeds. Indeed, they were a people of evil, defiantly disobedient.
tr: Walūṭan ātaynāhu ḥukmaw waʿilmaw wanajjaynāhu minal-qaryatil-latī kānat taʿmalul-khabāʾith, innahum kānū qawma sawʾin fāsiqīn

ar: وَأَدْخَلْنَٰهُ فِى رَحْمَتِنَآ إِنَّهُۥ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
en: (75) And We admitted him into Our mercy. Indeed, he was of the righteous.
tr: Waʾadkhalnāhu fī raḥmatinā, innahū minaṣ-ṣāliḥīn

ar: وَنُوحًا إِذْ نَادَىٰ مِن قَبْلُ فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ فَنَجَّيْنَٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
en: (76) And [mention] Noah, when he called [to Allāh][895] before [that time], so We responded to him and saved him and his family from the great affliction [i.e., the flood].
enNotes: [895]- i.e., supplicated against his people who had persisted in denial and animosity. See 71:26-28.
tr: Wanūḥan idh nādā min qablu fastajabnā lahū fanajjaynāhu waʾahlahū minal-karbil-ʿaẓīm

ar: وَنَصَرْنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمَ سَوْءٍ فَأَغْرَقْنَٰهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
en: (77) And We aided [i.e., saved] him from the people who denied Our signs. Indeed, they were a people of evil, so We drowned them, all together.
tr: Wanaṣarnāhu minal-qawmil-ladhīna kadhdhabū biʾāyātinā, innahum kānū qawma sawʾin faʾaghraqnāhum ajmaʿīn

ar: وَدَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيْمَٰنَ إِذْ يَحْكُمَانِ فِى ٱلْحَرْثِ إِذْ نَفَشَتْ فِيهِ غَنَمُ ٱلْقَوْمِ وَكُنَّا لِحُكْمِهِمْ شَٰهِدِينَ
en: (78) And [mention] David and Solomon, when they judged concerning the field - when the sheep of a people overran it [at night],[896] and We were witness to their judgement.
enNotes: [896]- Eating and destroying the crops.
tr: Wadāwūda wasulaymāna idh yaḥkumāni fil-ḥarthi idh nafashat fīhi ghanamul-qawm, wakunnā liḥukmihim shāhidīn

ar: فَفَهَّمْنَٰهَا سُلَيْمَٰنَ وَكُلًّا ءَاتَيْنَا حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا وَسَخَّرْنَا مَعَ دَاوُۥدَ ٱلْجِبَالَ يُسَبِّحْنَ وَٱلطَّيْرَ وَكُنَّا فَٰعِلِينَ
en: (79) And We gave understanding of it [i.e., the case] to Solomon, and to each [of them] We gave judgement and knowledge. And We subjected the mountains to exalt [Us], along with David and [also] the birds. And We were doing [that].[897]
enNotes: [897]- Meaning that Allāh has always been capable of accomplishing whatever He wills.
tr: Fafahhamnāhā sulaymān, wakullan ātaynā ḥukmaw waʿilmā, wasakhkharnā maʿa dāwūdal-jibāla yusabbiḥna waṭ-ṭayr, wakunnā fāʿilīn

ar: وَعَلَّمْنَٰهُ صَنْعَةَ لَبُوسٍ لَّكُمْ لِتُحْصِنَكُم مِّنۢ بَأْسِكُمْ فَهَلْ أَنتُمْ شَٰكِرُونَ
en: (80) And We taught him the fashioning of coats of armor to protect you from your [enemy in] battle. So will you then be grateful?
tr: Waʿallamnāhu ṣanʿata labūsil lakum lituḥṣinakum mim baʾsikum, fahal antum shākirūn

ar: وَلِسُلَيْمَٰنَ ٱلرِّيحَ عَاصِفَةً تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِى بَٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا وَكُنَّا بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَٰلِمِينَ
en: (81) And to Solomon [We subjected] the wind, blowing forcefully, proceeding by his command toward the land which We had blessed. And We are ever, of all things, Knowing.
tr: Walisulaymānar-rīḥa ʿāṣifatan tajrī biʾamrihī ilal-arḍil-latī bāraknā fīhā, wakunnā bikulli shayʾin ʿālimīn

ar: وَمِنَ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ مَن يَغُوصُونَ لَهُۥ وَيَعْمَلُونَ عَمَلًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَكُنَّا لَهُمْ حَٰفِظِينَ
en: (82) And of the devils [i.e., jinn] were those who dived for him and did work other than that. And We were of them a guardian.[898]
enNotes: [898]- Preventing any disobedience or deviation by them from Solomon's instructions and protecting him from being harmed by them.
tr: Waminash-shayāṭīni may yaghūṣūna lahū wayaʿmalūna ʿamalan dūna dhālik, wakunnā lahum ḥāfiẓīn

ar: وَأَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
en: (83) And [mention] Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, adversity has touched me, and You are the most merciful of the merciful."
tr: Waʾayyūba idh nādā rabbahū annī massaniyaḍ-ḍurru waʾanta arḥamur-rāḥimīn

ar: فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ فَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِۦ مِن ضُرٍّ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِلْعَٰبِدِينَ
en: (84) So We responded to him and removed what afflicted him of adversity. And We gave him [back] his family and the like thereof with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for the worshippers [of Allāh].
tr: Fastajabnā lahū fakashafnā mā bihī min ḍurriw waʾātaynāhu ahlahū wamithlahum maʿahum raḥmatam min ʿindinā wadhikrā lil-ʿābidīn

ar: وَإِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ كُلٌّ مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ
en: (85) And [mention] Ishmael and Idrees and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient.
tr: Waʾismāʿīla waʾidrīsa wadhal-kifl, kullum minaṣ-ṣābirīn

ar: وَأَدْخَلْنَٰهُمْ فِى رَحْمَتِنَآ إِنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
en: (86) And We admitted them into Our mercy. Indeed, they were of the righteous.
tr: Waʾadkhalnāhum fī raḥmatinā, innahum minaṣ-ṣāliḥīn

ar: وَذَا ٱلنُّونِ إِذ ذَّهَبَ مُغَٰضِبًا فَظَنَّ أَن لَّن نَّقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ فَنَادَىٰ فِى ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ أَن لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبْحَٰنَكَ إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
en: (87) And [mention] the man of the fish [i.e., Jonah], when he went off in anger[899] and thought that We would not decree [anything] upon him.[900] And he called out within the darknesses,[901] "There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers."
enNotes:
[899]- At the disbelief of his people.
[900]- Or "would not restrict him" in the belly of the fish.
[901]- That of the night, of the sea, and of the fish's interior.
tr: Wadhan-nūni idh dhahaba mughāḍiban faẓanna al lan naqdira ʿalayhi fanādā fiẓ-ẓulumāti al lā ilāha illā anta subḥānaka innī kuntu minaẓ-ẓālimīn

ar: فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ وَنَجَّيْنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْغَمِّ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُـۨجِى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
en: (88) So We responded to him and saved him from the distress. And thus do We save the believers.
tr: Fastajabnā lahū wanajjaynāhu minal-ghamm, wakadhālika nujil-muʾminīn

ar: وَزَكَرِيَّآ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِى فَرْدًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْوَٰرِثِينَ
en: (89) And [mention] Zechariah, when he called to his Lord, "My Lord, do not leave me alone [with no heir], while You are the best of inheritors."
tr: Wazakariyyā idh nādā rabbahū rabbi lā tadharnī fardaw waʾanta khayrul-wārithīn

ar: فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥ يَحْيَىٰ وَأَصْلَحْنَا لَهُۥ زَوْجَهُۥٓ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ يُسَٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَيَدْعُونَنَا رَغَبًا وَرَهَبًا وَكَانُوا۟ لَنَا خَٰشِعِينَ
en: (90) So We responded to him, and We gave to him John, and amended for him his wife. Indeed, they used to hasten to good deeds and supplicate[902] Us in hope and fear, and they were to Us humbly submissive.
enNotes: [902]- i.e., worship.
tr: Fastajabnā lah, wawahabnā lahū yaḥyā waʾaṣlaḥnā lahū zawjah, innahum kānū yusāriʿūna fil-khayrāti wayadʿūnanā raghabaw warahabā, wakānū lanā khāshiʿīn

ar: وَٱلَّتِىٓ أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهَا مِن رُّوحِنَا وَجَعَلْنَٰهَا وَٱبْنَهَآ ءَايَةً لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ
en: (91) And [mention] the one who guarded her chastity [i.e., Mary], so We blew into her [garment] through Our angel [i.e., Gabriel], and We made her and her son a sign for the worlds.
tr: Wal-latī aḥṣanat farjahā fanafakhnā fīhā mir rūḥinā wajaʿalnāhā wabnahā āyatal lil-ʿālamīn

ar: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦٓ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً وَأَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُونِ
en: (92) Indeed this, your religion, is one religion,[903] and I am your Lord, so worship Me.
enNotes: [903]- i.e., a collective way of life or course of conduct followed by a community.
tr: Inna hādhihī ummatukum ummataw wāḥidah, waʾana rabbukum faʿbudūn

ar: وَتَقَطَّعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ كُلٌّ إِلَيْنَا رَٰجِعُونَ
en: (93) And [yet] they divided their affair [i.e., that of their religion] among themselves,[904] [but] all to Us will return.
enNotes: [904]- Becoming sects and denominations.
tr: Wataqaṭṭaʿū amrahum baynahum, kullun ilaynā rājiʿūn

ar: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَا كُفْرَانَ لِسَعْيِهِۦ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ كَٰتِبُونَ
en: (94) So whoever does righteous deeds while he is a believer - no denial will there be for his effort,[905] and indeed We [i.e., Our angels], of it, are recorders.
enNotes: [905]- Such a person will not be deprived of his due reward.
tr: Famay yaʿmal minaṣ-ṣāliḥāti wahuwa muʾminun falā kufrāna lisaʿyih, waʾinnā lahū kātibūn

ar: وَحَرَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَٰهَآ أَنَّهُمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ
en: (95) And it is prohibited to [the people of] a city which We have destroyed that they will [ever] return[906]
enNotes: [906]- They cannot return to this world, nor can they repent to Allāh.
tr: Waḥarāmun ʿalā qaryatin ahlaknāhā annahum lā yarjiʿūn

ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فُتِحَتْ يَأْجُوجُ وَمَأْجُوجُ وَهُم مِّن كُلِّ حَدَبٍ يَنسِلُونَ
en: (96) Until when [the dam of] Gog and Magog has been opened and they, from every elevation, descend
tr: Ḥattā idhā futiḥat yaʾjūju wamaʾjūju wahum min kulli ḥadabiy yansilūn

ar: وَٱقْتَرَبَ ٱلْوَعْدُ ٱلْحَقُّ فَإِذَا هِىَ شَٰخِصَةٌ أَبْصَٰرُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يَٰوَيْلَنَا قَدْ كُنَّا فِى غَفْلَةٍ مِّنْ هَٰذَا بَلْ كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
en: (97) And [when] the true promise [i.e., the resurrection] has approached; then suddenly the eyes of those who disbelieved will be staring [in horror, while they say], "O woe to us; we had been unmindful of this; rather, we were wrongdoers."
tr: Waqtarabal-waʿdul-ḥaqqu faʾidhā hiya shākhiṣatun abṣārul-ladhīna kafarū, yāwaylanā qad kunnā fī ghaflatim min hādhā bal kunnā ẓālimīn

ar: إِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ حَصَبُ جَهَنَّمَ أَنتُمْ لَهَا وَٰرِدُونَ
en: (98) Indeed, you [disbelievers] and what you worship other than Allāh are the firewood of Hell. You will be coming to [enter] it.
tr: Innakum wamā taʿbudūna min dūnillāhi ḥaṣabu jahannam, antum lahā wāridūn

ar: لَوْ كَانَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ءَالِهَةً مَّا وَرَدُوهَا وَكُلٌّ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
en: (99) Had these [false deities] been [actual] gods, they would not have come to it, but all are eternal therein.
tr: Law kāna hāʾulāʾi ālihatam mā waradūhā, wakullun fīhā khālidūn

ar: لَهُمْ فِيهَا زَفِيرٌ وَهُمْ فِيهَا لَا يَسْمَعُونَ
en: (100) For them therein is heavy sighing, and they therein will not hear.
tr: Lahum fīhā zafīruw wahum fīhā lā yasmaʿūn

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ سَبَقَتْ لَهُم مِّنَّا ٱلْحُسْنَىٰٓ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ عَنْهَا مُبْعَدُونَ
en: (101) Indeed, those for whom the best [reward] has preceded from Us - they are from it far removed.
tr: Innal-ladhīna sabaqat lahum minnal-ḥusnā ulāʾika ʿanhā mubʿadūn

ar: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ حَسِيسَهَا وَهُمْ فِى مَا ٱشْتَهَتْ أَنفُسُهُمْ خَٰلِدُونَ
en: (102) They will not hear its sound, while they are, in that which their souls desire, abiding eternally.
tr: Lā yasmaʿūna ḥasīsahā, wahum fī mashtahat anfusuhum khālidūn

ar: لَا يَحْزُنُهُمُ ٱلْفَزَعُ ٱلْأَكْبَرُ وَتَتَلَقَّىٰهُمُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ هَٰذَا يَوْمُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
en: (103) They will not be grieved by the greatest terror,[907] and the angels will meet them, [saying], "This is your Day which you have been promised" -
enNotes: [907]- The events of the Last Hour or of the Resurrection.
tr: Lā yaḥzunuhumul-fazaʿul-akbaru watatalaqqāhumul-malāʾikah, hādhā yawmukumul-ladhī kuntum tūʿadūn

ar: يَوْمَ نَطْوِى ٱلسَّمَآءَ كَطَىِّ ٱلسِّجِلِّ لِلْكُتُبِ كَمَا بَدَأْنَآ أَوَّلَ خَلْقٍ نُّعِيدُهُۥ وَعْدًا عَلَيْنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا فَٰعِلِينَ
en: (104) The Day when We will fold the heaven like the folding of a [written] sheet for the records. As We began the first creation, We will repeat it. [That is] a promise binding upon Us. Indeed, We will do it.[908]
enNotes: [908]- More literally, "Indeed, We are ever doers" of what We will.
tr: Yawma naṭwis-samāʾa kaṭayyis-sijilli lil-kutub, kamā badaʾnā awwala khalqin nuʿīduh, waʿdan ʿalaynā, innā kunnā fāʿilīn

ar: وَلَقَدْ كَتَبْنَا فِى ٱلزَّبُورِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ٱلذِّكْرِ أَنَّ ٱلْأَرْضَ يَرِثُهَا عِبَادِىَ ٱلصَّٰلِحُونَ
en: (105) And We have already written in the book [of Psalms][909] after the [previous] mention[910] that the land [of Paradise] is inherited by My righteous servants.
enNotes:
[909]- Az-Zabūr can also mean "scriptures" in general.
[910]- i.e., the Torah. The "mention" may also refer to the original inscription with Allāh, i.e., the Preserved Slate (al-Lawḥ al-Maḥfūẓ).
tr: Walaqad katabnā fiz-zabūri mim baʿdidh-dhikri annal-arḍa yarithuhā ʿibādiyaṣ-ṣāliḥūn

ar: إِنَّ فِى هَٰذَا لَبَلَٰغًا لِّقَوْمٍ عَٰبِدِينَ
en: (106) Indeed, in this [Qur’ān] is notification for a worshipping people.
tr: Inna fī hādhā labalāghal liqawmin ʿābidīn

ar: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ إِلَّا رَحْمَةً لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ
en: (107) And We have not sent you, [O Muḥammad], except as a mercy to the worlds.
tr: Wamā arsalnāka illā raḥmatal lil-ʿālamīn

ar: قُلْ إِنَّمَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَٰهُكُمْ إِلَٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّسْلِمُونَ
en: (108) Say, "It is only revealed to me that your god is but one God; so will you be Muslims [in submission to Him]?"
tr: Qul innamā yūḥā ilayya annamā ilāhukum ilāhuw wāḥid, fahal antum muslimūn

ar: فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَقُلْ ءَاذَنتُكُمْ عَلَىٰ سَوَآءٍ وَإِنْ أَدْرِىٓ أَقَرِيبٌ أَم بَعِيدٌ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ
en: (109) But if they turn away, then say, "I have announced to [all of] you equally.[911] And I know not whether near or far is that which you are promised.
enNotes: [911]- The Prophet (ﷺ) made this message known to all people, not concealing any of it from anyone or preferring any group over another.
tr: Faʾin tawallaw faqul ādhantukum ʿalā sawāʾ, waʾin adrī aqarībun am baʿīdum mā tūʿadūn

ar: إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَكْتُمُونَ
en: (110) Indeed, He knows what is declared of speech, and He knows what you conceal.
tr: Innahū yaʿlamul-jahra minal-qawli wayaʿlamu mā taktumūn

ar: وَإِنْ أَدْرِى لَعَلَّهُۥ فِتْنَةٌ لَّكُمْ وَمَتَٰعٌ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
en: (111) And I know not; perhaps it[912] is a trial for you and enjoyment for a time."
enNotes: [912]- The postponement of punishment.
tr: Waʾin adrī laʿallahū fitnatul lakum wamatāʿun ilā ḥīn

ar: قَٰلَ رَبِّ ٱحْكُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَرَبُّنَا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ٱلْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَىٰ مَا تَصِفُونَ
en: (112) [The Prophet (ﷺ)] has said, "My Lord, judge [between us] in truth. And our Lord is the Most Merciful, the one whose help is sought against that which you describe."[913]
enNotes: [913]- i.e., their lies and disbelief.
tr: Qāla rabbiḥkum bil-ḥaqq, warabbunar-raḥmānul-mustaʿānu ʿalā mā taṣifūn
